Overview: Breaking down our FY24 Scope 3 emissions by source
Microsoft’s Scope 3 emissions continue to account for more than 97% of our total emissions.
Tackling Scope 3 means decarbonizing industrial processes such as steel, concrete, and other
building material production for use in our campus and datacenter construction, as well as
jet fuel for business travel and logistics, with the vast majority of these emissions coming
from two categories upstream, Purchased Goods and Services (Category 1) and Capital
Goods (Category 2), and one downstream, Use of Sold Products (Category 11).
